Tributes for Professor Peter Ng as he steps down as Head of LKCNHM

Content Writing | Science Communication & Museum Editorial
 Org Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum (National University of Singapore)
 Role Author (Feature Writing & Institutional Storytelling)
 Focus Portrait of a scientist and institution-builder told through the voices of his colleagues
 Read 🔗 Read Here

Prof Peter Ng explicitly dislikes being celebrated. He would reinstate himself just to fire us if we did that. Instead, this piece builds his portrait entirely through the voices of colleagues and friends, letting specific memories (a stonefish injury, a hat lost at sea, a bag of crabs) do what a list of achievements never could: show the kind of man he is.
